Desc.value: A combat ally protection mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that prevents friendly fire and provides intelligent target selection.

Desc: Structure and chunk-gen orchestrator for apocalypse map-making. Coordinates Lost Cities, RoadWeaver, and structure mods so roads and buildings play nicely. One-click world presets, configurable structure limits, and road-first or structure-first placement.

Calm The Leaks (CTL) is a Forge server-side helper mod that filters, contextualizes, and rate-limits AllTheLeaks output, distinguishing harmless baseline chunk retention from real memory leaks so admins stop panicking over noise.
